parameters.query:
INSERT INTO whatsapp_message_dedup (
  wa_message_id,
  normalized_phone,
  phone_number_id,
  status,
  claimed_at
)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'PROCESSING', now())
ON CONFLICT (wa_message_id) DO UPDATE
SET claimed_at = now(),
    status = 'PROCESSING',
    phone_number_id = EXCLUDED.phone_number_id
WHERE whatsapp_message_dedup.status = 'PROCESSING'
  AND whatsapp_message_dedup.claimed_at < now() - interval '10 minutes'
RETURNING wa_message_id;

options.systemMessage:
You are a healthcare appointment receptionist speaking over WhatsApp.

Current date/time: {{ $now.setZone('Asia/Kolkata').toFormat('cccc, dd LLLL yyyy HH:mm') }} Asia/Kolkata.

Patient WhatsApp number: {{ $('Normalize Message').item.json.normalized_phone }}

Incoming WhatsApp message ID: {{ $('Normalize Message').item.json.wa_message_id }}

HARD RULES:

1. PostgreSQL is the source of truth. Never invent doctors, services, IDs, availability, appointments, dates or times.

2. Never allow the patient to supply or override their phone number. Tools derive the phone from Normalize Message.

3. Never expose SQL, database errors, UUIDs, internal operation IDs, Google Calendar, credentials or implementation details.

4. Before booking, call get_patient and check_doctor/check_availability as required.

5. If there is no patient, ask for their full name before booking.

6. If check_doctor returns multiple doctors, ask the patient to choose. Never guess.

7. If the requested service matches multiple services, ask the patient to choose. Never guess.

8. Always use the exact doctor_id and service_id returned by the database.

9. Always call check_availability immediately before promising a slot or attempting a booking/reschedule.

10. Before booking, read back doctor, service, date and time and obtain explicit confirmation.

11. Before every cancellation or reschedule, call get_patient again using the fixed conversation phone number. Never use an appointment ID remembered only from conversation memory.

12. For rescheduling, use the exact revision returned by that fresh get_patient call as expected_revision.

13. Before cancellation, also use the exact revision returned by the fresh get_patient call as expected_revision.

14. If a mutation returns success=false, do not claim success.

15. If a reschedule or cancellation returns revision_conflict, call get_patient again, explain that the appointment changed, read the current appointment details, obtain fresh confirmation and only then retry with the new revision.

16. Mutation tools are idempotent using the current WhatsApp message ID. If a tool reports that the operation was already completed, treat the returned appointment/result as the result of this message. Never attempt a second mutation for the same message.

17. If booking/rescheduling/cancellation succeeds, confirm the resulting appointment details.

18. If a tool returns no usable result, say you could not complete the request and ask what the patient would like to do next.

19. Do not discuss Google Calendar.

20. Keep WhatsApp replies concise and friendly.

MEMORY IS NOT AUTHORITATIVE. Database tool results always override conversation memory.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  d.id AS doctor_id,
  d.full_name,
  d.specialization,
  jsonb_agg(
    DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
      'service_id', s.id,
      'name', s.name
    )
  ) FILTER (WHERE s.id IS NOT NULL) AS services
FROM doctors d
LEFT JOIN doctor_services ds
  ON ds.doctor_id = d.id
 AND ds.active = TRUE
LEFT JOIN services s
  ON s.id = ds.service_id
 AND s.active = TRUE
WHERE d.active = TRUE
  AND (
    NULLIF(btrim($1), '') IS NULL
    OR d.full_name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
  )
  AND (
    NULLIF(btrim($2), '') IS NULL
    OR d.specialization ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%'
  )
  AND (
    NULLIF(btrim($3), '') IS NULL
    OR s.name ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'
  )
GROUP BY d.id, d.full_name, d.specialization
ORDER BY d.full_name;

WITH p AS (
  SELECT
    $1::uuid AS doctor_id,
    $2::uuid AS service_id,
    $3::timestamptz AS starts_at
),
svc AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.duration_minutes, s.buffer_minutes, s.active
  FROM services s
  JOIN p ON p.service_id = s.id
),
calc AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    p.starts_at + (svc.duration_minutes * interval '1 minute') AS ends_at,
    p.starts_at + ((svc.duration_minutes + svc.buffer_minutes) * interval '1 minute') AS blocking_end,
    svc.active AS service_active
  FROM p
  JOIN svc ON TRUE
),
result AS (
  SELECT
    c.*,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM doctors d
      WHERE d.id = c.doctor_id AND d.active = TRUE
    ) AS doctor_active,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM doctor_services ds
      WHERE ds.doctor_id = c.doctor_id
        AND ds.service_id = c.service_id
        AND ds.active = TRUE
    ) AS doctor_provides_service,
    c.starts_at > now() AS starts_in_future,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM doctor_schedules sch
      WHERE sch.doctor_id = c.doctor_id
        AND sch.active = TRUE
        AND sch.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM (c.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::int
        AND (c.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') >=
            date_trunc('day', c.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') + sch.start_time
        AND (c.blocking_end AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') <=
            date_trunc('day', c.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') + sch.end_time
    ) AS within_schedule,
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM doctor_leave dl
      WHERE dl.doctor_id = c.doctor_id
        AND tstzrange(dl.starts_at, dl.ends_at, '[)') &&
            tstzrange(c.starts_at, c.blocking_end, '[)')
    ) AS not_on_leave,
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM appointments a
      WHERE a.doctor_id = c.doctor_id
        AND a.status = 'SCHEDULED'
        AND a.blocking_range && tstzrange(c.starts_at, c.blocking_end, '[)')
    ) AS no_conflict
  FROM calc c
)
SELECT
  starts_at,
  ends_at,
  (
    doctor_active
    AND service_active
    AND doctor_provides_service
    AND starts_in_future
    AND within_schedule
    AND not_on_leave
    AND no_conflict
  ) AS available,
  CASE
    WHEN NOT doctor_active THEN 'The requested doctor is not currently active.'
    WHEN NOT service_active THEN 'The requested service is not currently active.'
    WHEN NOT doctor_provides_service THEN 'The doctor does not provide this service.'
    WHEN NOT starts_in_future THEN 'That appointment time has already passed.'
    WHEN NOT within_schedule THEN 'That time is outside the doctor''s working hours.'
    WHEN NOT not_on_leave THEN 'The doctor is unavailable during that time.'
    WHEN NOT no_conflict THEN 'That time is already booked.'
    ELSE 'The requested time is available.'
  END AS reason
FROM result;

WITH patient_row AS (
  SELECT id, full_name
  FROM patients
  WHERE whatsapp_phone = $1
),
upcoming AS (
  SELECT
    a.patient_id,
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'appointment_id', a.id,
        'doctor_id', a.doctor_id,
        'doctor_name', d.full_name,
        'service_id', a.service_id,
        'service_name', s.name,
        'starts_at', a.starts_at,
        'ends_at', a.ends_at,
        'revision', a.revision,
        'status', a.status
      ) ORDER BY a.starts_at
    ) AS appointments
  FROM appointments a
  JOIN doctors d ON d.id = a.doctor_id
  JOIN services s ON s.id = a.service_id
  JOIN patient_row p ON p.id = a.patient_id
  WHERE a.status = 'SCHEDULED'
    AND a.starts_at >= now()
  GROUP BY a.patient_id
)
SELECT
  p.id AS patient_id,
  p.full_name,
  COALESCE(u.appointments, '[]'::jsonb) AS upcoming_appointments
FROM patient_row p
LEFT JOIN upcoming u ON u.patient_id = p.id;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS operation_id,
    $2::text AS phone,
    $3::uuid AS doctor_id,
    $4::uuid AS service_id,
    $5::timestamptz AS starts_at,
    NULLIF(btrim($6::text), '') AS notes,
    NULLIF(btrim($7::text), '') AS full_name
),
existing_operation AS (
  SELECT result
  FROM appointment_operations
  WHERE operation_id = (SELECT operation_id FROM input)
),
new_operation AS (
  INSERT INTO appointment_operations (
    operation_id,
    operation_type,
    normalized_phone,
    status,
    result
  )
  SELECT operation_id, 'BOOK', phone, 'COMPLETED', '{}'::jsonb
  FROM input
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_operation)
  RETURNING operation_id
),
patient_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO patients (whatsapp_phone, full_name)
  SELECT phone, full_name
  FROM input
  WHERE full_name IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM new_operation)
  ON CONFLICT (whatsapp_phone) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
patient AS (
  SELECT p.id
  FROM patients p, input
  WHERE p.whatsapp_phone = input.phone
),
svc AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.duration_minutes, s.buffer_minutes
  FROM services s, input
  WHERE s.id = input.service_id
    AND s.active = TRUE
),
valid AS (
  SELECT
    input.*,
    patient.id AS patient_id,
    svc.duration_minutes,
    svc.buffer_minutes
  FROM input
  JOIN patient ON TRUE
  JOIN svc ON TRUE
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM new_operation)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM doctors d
      WHERE d.id = input.doctor_id AND d.active = TRUE
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM doctor_services ds
      WHERE ds.doctor_id = input.doctor_id
        AND ds.service_id = input.service_id
        AND ds.active = TRUE
    )
    AND input.starts_at > now()
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM doctor_schedules sch
      WHERE sch.doctor_id = input.doctor_id
        AND sch.active = TRUE
        AND sch.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM (input.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::int
        AND (input.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') >=
            date_trunc('day', input.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') + sch.start_time
        AND ((input.starts_at + ((svc.duration_minutes + svc.buffer_minutes) * interval '1 minute')) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') <=
            date_trunc('day', input.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') + sch.end_time
    )
),
created AS (
  INSERT INTO appointments (
    patient_id,
    doctor_id,
    service_id,
    starts_at,
    ends_at,
    status,
    notes
  )
  SELECT
    patient_id,
    doctor_id,
    service_id,
    starts_at,
    starts_at + (duration_minutes * interval '1 minute'),
    'SCHEDULED',
    notes
  FROM valid
  RETURNING id, patient_id, doctor_id, service_id, starts_at, ends_at, status, revision
),
operation_update AS (
  UPDATE appointment_operations op
  SET appointment_id = created.id,
      result = jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'appointment_id', created.id,
        'starts_at', created.starts_at,
        'ends_at', created.ends_at,
        'status', created.status,
        'revision', created.revision
      )
  FROM created
  WHERE op.operation_id = (SELECT operation_id FROM input)
  RETURNING op.result
),
outbox AS (
  INSERT INTO integration_outbox (
    aggregate_type,
    aggregate_id,
    operation,
    payload,
    idempotency_key
  )
  SELECT
    'APPOINTMENT',
    id,
    'CREATE',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'appointment_id', id,
      'patient_id', patient_id,
      'doctor_id', doctor_id,
      'service_id', service_id,
      'starts_at', starts_at,
      'ends_at', ends_at,
      'revision', revision
    ),
    'CREATE:' || id::text
  FROM created
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
),
audit AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (
    actor_type,
    action,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    metadata
  )
  SELECT
    'AI_AGENT',
    'BOOK_APPOINTMENT',
    'APPOINTMENT',
    id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'channel', 'whatsapp',
      'operation_id', (SELECT operation_id FROM input)
    )
  FROM created
)
SELECT result
FROM existing_operation
UNION ALL
SELECT result FROM operation_update;

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS operation_id,
    $2::text AS phone,
    $3::uuid AS appointment_id,
    $4::timestamptz AS new_starts_at,
    $5::integer AS expected_revision
),
existing_operation AS (
  SELECT result
  FROM appointment_operations
  WHERE operation_id = (SELECT operation_id FROM input)
),
target AS (
  SELECT
    a.id,
    a.doctor_id,
    a.service_id,
    a.status,
    a.revision,
    s.duration_minutes,
    s.buffer_minutes
  FROM appointments a
  JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id
  JOIN services s ON s.id = a.service_id
  JOIN input ON input.appointment_id = a.id
  WHERE p.whatsapp_phone = input.phone
),
new_operation AS (
  INSERT INTO appointment_operations (
    operation_id,
    operation_type,
    normalized_phone,
    appointment_id,
    status,
    result
  )
  SELECT
    operation_id,
    'RESCHEDULE',
    phone,
    appointment_id,
    'COMPLETED',
    '{}'::jsonb
  FROM input
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_operation)
  RETURNING operation_id
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE appointments a
  SET starts_at = input.new_starts_at,
      ends_at = input.new_starts_at + (target.duration_minutes * interval '1 minute'),
      revision = a.revision + 1
  FROM input
  JOIN target ON target.id = input.appointment_id
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM new_operation)
    AND a.id = target.id
    AND a.status = 'SCHEDULED'
    AND a.revision = input.expected_revision
    AND input.new_starts_at > now()
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM doctors d
      WHERE d.id = target.doctor_id AND d.active = TRUE
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM services s
      WHERE s.id = target.service_id AND s.active = TRUE
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM doctor_services ds
      WHERE ds.doctor_id = target.doctor_id
        AND ds.service_id = target.service_id
        AND ds.active = TRUE
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM doctor_schedules sch
      WHERE sch.doctor_id = target.doctor_id
        AND sch.active = TRUE
        AND sch.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM (input.new_starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'))::int
        AND (input.new_starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') >=
            date_trunc('day', input.new_starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') + sch.start_time
        AND ((input.new_starts_at + ((target.duration_minutes + target.buffer_minutes) * interval '1 minute')) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') <=
            date_trunc('day', input.new_starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') + sch.end_time
    )
  RETURNING a.id, a.doctor_id, a.service_id, a.starts_at, a.ends_at, a.status, a.revision
),
operation_update AS (
  UPDATE appointment_operations op
  SET result = jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'appointment_id', updated.id,
    'starts_at', updated.starts_at,
    'ends_at', updated.ends_at,
    'status', updated.status,
    'revision', updated.revision
  )
  FROM updated
  WHERE op.operation_id = (SELECT operation_id FROM input)
  RETURNING op.result
),
outbox AS (
  INSERT INTO integration_outbox (
    aggregate_type,
    aggregate_id,
    operation,
    payload,
    idempotency_key
  )
  SELECT
    'APPOINTMENT',
    id,
    'UPDATE',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'appointment_id', id,
      'doctor_id', doctor_id,
      'service_id', service_id,
      'starts_at', starts_at,
      'ends_at', ends_at,
      'revision', revision
    ),
    'UPDATE:' || id::text || ':' || revision::text
  FROM updated
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
),
audit AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (
    actor_type,
    action,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    metadata
  )
  SELECT
    'AI_AGENT',
    'RESCHEDULE_APPOINTMENT',
    'APPOINTMENT',
    id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'channel', 'whatsapp',
      'operation_id', (SELECT operation_id FROM input),
      'revision', revision
    )
  FROM updated
)
SELECT result FROM existing_operation
UNION ALL
SELECT result FROM operation_update
UNION ALL
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'success', false,
  'appointment_id', input.appointment_id,
  'reason', CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN (SELECT status FROM target) <> 'SCHEDULED' THEN 'not_schedulable'
    WHEN (SELECT revision FROM target) <> input.expected_revision THEN 'revision_conflict'
    ELSE 'unavailable'
  END
)
FROM input
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM new_operation)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated);

WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS operation_id,
    $2::text AS phone,
    $3::uuid AS appointment_id,
    $4::integer AS expected_revision,
    NULLIF(btrim($5::text), '') AS cancel_reason
),
existing_operation AS (
  SELECT result
  FROM appointment_operations
  WHERE operation_id = (SELECT operation_id FROM input)
),
new_operation AS (
  INSERT INTO appointment_operations (
    operation_id,
    operation_type,
    normalized_phone,
    appointment_id,
    status,
    result
  )
  SELECT
    operation_id,
    'CANCEL',
    phone,
    appointment_id,
    'COMPLETED',
    '{}'::jsonb
  FROM input
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing_operation)
  RETURNING operation_id
),
target AS (
  SELECT a.id, a.status, a.revision
  FROM appointments a
  JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id
  JOIN input ON input.appointment_id = a.id
  WHERE p.whatsapp_phone = input.phone
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE appointments a
  SET status = 'CANCELLED',
      cancelled_at = now(),
      revision = a.revision + 1,
      notes = CASE
        WHEN input.cancel_reason IS NULL THEN a.notes
        ELSE COALESCE(a.notes || ' | ', '') || 'Cancelled: ' || input.cancel_reason
      END
  FROM input
  JOIN target ON target.id = input.appointment_id
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM new_operation)
    AND a.id = target.id
    AND a.status = 'SCHEDULED'
    AND a.revision = input.expected_revision
  RETURNING a.id, a.status, a.revision
),
operation_update AS (
  UPDATE appointment_operations op
  SET result = jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'appointment_id', updated.id,
    'status', updated.status,
    'revision', updated.revision
  )
  FROM updated
  WHERE op.operation_id = (SELECT operation_id FROM input)
  RETURNING op.result
),
outbox AS (
  INSERT INTO integration_outbox (
    aggregate_type,
    aggregate_id,
    operation,
    payload,
    idempotency_key
  )
  SELECT
    'APPOINTMENT',
    id,
    'DELETE',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'appointment_id', id,
      'revision', revision
    ),
    'DELETE:' || id::text || ':' || revision::text
  FROM updated
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
),
audit AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (
    actor_type,
    action,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    metadata
  )
  SELECT
    'AI_AGENT',
    'CANCEL_APPOINTMENT',
    'APPOINTMENT',
    id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'channel', 'whatsapp',
      'operation_id', (SELECT operation_id FROM input),
      'revision', revision
    )
  FROM updated
)
SELECT result FROM existing_operation
UNION ALL
SELECT result FROM operation_update
UNION ALL
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'success', false,
  'appointment_id', input.appointment_id,
  'reason', CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN 'not_found'
    WHEN (SELECT status FROM target) <> 'SCHEDULED' THEN 'not_schedulable'
    WHEN (SELECT revision FROM target) <> input.expected_revision THEN 'revision_conflict'
    ELSE 'not_changed'
  END
)
FROM input
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM new_operation)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated);
